text: On Halloween 1977, Jack Delroy, host of the struggling late-night talk show Night Owls, stages a live occult special [to lift his sagging ratings|wants|fame and worship], not long after his wife Madeleine has died of cancer. His guests include a psychic, a sceptical former magician and the parapsychologist June Ross-Mitchell with her subject, thirteen-year-old Lilly, sole survivor of a Satanic church's mass suicide, who [claims a demon lives inside her|threat|being taken over]. As June [conjures it before the cameras|trigger|calling on unseen powers], the demon says it has met Jack before, under the tall trees.
